prs.title: Retain sanitized ICSE network failure evidence
prs.body:
When the ICSE network command fails, CI currently skips its public artifact upload, and the report omits the failing worker/operation/error classification. D18's two native failures therefore lost actionable context.

Preserve the existing public output after an attempted command succeeds or fails, and record only allowlisted worker, operation, error type and error code for unexpected worker-command failures. Unknown values are redacted. Failure still exits 1, owned children still stop, and private-state stays private. The original dependency installation commands, deadlines, assertions, OS matrix, triggers and product/runtime source are unchanged.

Validation on repair head 70163ea908741baa1999a9c1084f0805d85dea64: 33 focused Windows tests pass (including failure reporting, teardown, redaction and artifact-bundle checks); the three new regressions fail on exact base b7194820 because public command context is absent. Ruff and diff hygiene pass. Parsed YAML comparison confirms that only a step identifier and public-upload name/condition changed.

Repairs D20/#482 harness observability only. D18/#480 remains unresolved; this is not a runtime fix, release qualification or physical acceptance evidence. PR #475 remains at its existing head. No manual full candidate qualification was started.

Durable evidence: [D20 entry](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/diagnostics/D20.md), [focused validation](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/diagnostics/D20-repair-focused-validation.json), [coordination checkpoint](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/QUALIFICATION_COORDINATION.md).

prs.title: fix: preserve Windows refusal responses for segmented POST bodies
prs.body:
A valid POST to an unknown responder path can produce WinError 10053 on Windows instead of HTTP 404 when its body arrives after its headers. The responder now sends the existing refusal immediately, then discards a valid declared body within the existing 4096-byte limit and one absolute 10-second cleanup budget before closing. EOF, timeout or socket error ends cleanup. Identity checks, secrets and the pairing authority remain inaccessible on this refusal path; supported join behavior is unchanged.

Refs #474 (D13). This is a separate two-file product repair from CI retirement PR #473. No workflow, runner, dependency or deployment changes.

Validation for head `5e6f184311019b9982e8544a18f3dc02c1b16e98`:
- The new synchronized regression fails on unchanged base `b7194820d8f1940ae60b8c9639e09b7f61e65c55`: the server closes before the declared body arrives after delivering 404.
- All 46 responder tests pass on native Windows Python 3.12.10 and Linux Python 3.12.13, including segmented body, invalid/oversized lengths, EOF/socket errors and an absolute deadline under trickling input.
- Changed-file Ruff, syntax and diff hygiene pass.
- Broader Windows discovery: 163 passed and 7 platform skips; one local fallback-Python PATH failure subsequently passed alone with CI-equivalent child-only venv PATH. Original failure is retained. This is 164 unique passing tests across those executions, not a claim of one entirely green invocation.
- Automatic PR checks are running. Initial branding and Linux update passed at native checkout `a5e743fee24e27bfd8d6d4f57c8efd589c6c3a42`, whose tree is identical to the PR head. No full candidate qualification was manually dispatched.

[Focused source-bound proof and raw JUnit](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/diagnostics/D13-focused-proof.json), [original diagnostic evidence](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/diagnostics/D13.md), [repair plan](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/codex/federation-v1-diagnostic-sweep-20260911/handoff/D13_REPAIR_PLAN.md).

Draft pending required CI and correctness review. No physical acceptance evidence, protected Recorder-data access or P07/P12 execution.

prs.title: ci: retire eight hosted phase workflows after native coverage proof
prs.body:
The eight hosted F7.1–F7.7 and F8.4 gates duplicate coverage now preserved by the native closeout/release workflows. Following the separately merged extension #468, this removes those eight files and updates the cleanup manifest and documentation references. All1406 other tracked entries, including every retained workflow, test, runner setting, command, trigger, dependency and product file, remain byte-identical to base `b7194820d8f1940ae60b8c9639e09b7f61e65c55`.

Replacement proof is preserved under its original source IDs:

- F7: two complete green Linux/Windows executions, including the real AI-JavaScript-only automatic event from closed/unmerged canary #469. Strict UP035, relay lint, transfer scopes and12 Windows modules are preserved.
- F8.4: two existing green native F8 matrices plus Linux/Windows release lint checks on each source. No replacement job was rerun to create this proof.
- Exact deletion inventory and old-to-new command/OS/path/service mapping were pushed before deletion. No external executable or current required-check consumer was found. The two OSL references and manifest are updated; no literal legacy filename references remain. Repository indexing excludes .github and already invalidates changed-document fingerprints.

Exact head `440123f6bc6dc358eef3d233236bc14f91af60e0`: clean checkout, branding,29 focused F7 contract tests, source/blob comparison and diff hygiene PASS. Native final-source validation and applicable automatic CI are pending; keep draft until reviewed. A scoped F7 dispatch validates this deletion head because existing F7 path filters do not match deleted sibling workflows; it does not replace the already-proven real JS-only event.

[Pre-deletion proof and inventory](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/dae1225b/handoff/diagnostics/phase-workflow-retirement-preflight.json) · [Native F8/release logs](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/dae1225b/handoff/diagnostics/f84-existing-native-proof-logs.zip) · [Exact final-head validation](https://github.com/Nettking/msh/blob/314c77bd/handoff/diagnostics/phase-retirement-final-head-validation.json).

Original host findings #470/#471/#472 remain open and distinct from this coverage-preserving cleanup; no product repair is claimed. Hosted spending-limit admission failures are infrastructure evidence. No physical/runtime state, protected Recorder data, runner accounts/pools or acceptance criteria change. These runs are CI evidence only, with no physical acceptance PASS.
